caption:
One of last season's guests was a Swede who has skied the Alps for decades. He stayed with us for three weeks. He's the type who tells you when something is good — and just as quickly when it isn't. We like that type.

His summary afterwards: close to 50 cm of fresh snow almost every day he was out. A couple of days the snow had settled, but out of three weeks, 70–80% were deep powder days.

That's not us exaggerating. That's just what a January in Hokkaido looks like when you stay long enough to catch every cycle.

Send us a message if you want to hear which weeks are still open next season.
